scope: folds-3/4 cross-fit viability test of a frozen Prithvi-EO-2.0-100M-TL CLS probe fused with the Gaussian+DOFA champion

representation.features: concatenated CLS tokens after blocks 3, 6, 9, and 12
representation.normalization: source fit rows and unlabeled held fold use separate per-feature mean/std
representation.fusion: logit blend with already-selected Gaussian+DOFA champion

search.selection_rule: worst-fold AP, pooled AP, worst-sensor AP, matched-FPR recall, smaller blend, then C closest to 0.003

gates.pass_action: extract and confirm the selected fixed probe on folds 0/1 before external scoring
gates.failure_action: reject the 100M CLS path before confirmation or external scoring

smoke.scope: finite regularized probe fit/predict without a held metric

invariants: Draft status permits finite fit/predict smoke only; all score outcomes require a frozen committed protocol.
Every MARS score is cross-fitted by physical-site fold and no held label enters normalization or fitting.
The comparator is the actual Gaussian+DOFA champion, not an earlier spatial-Prithvi score.
Only folds 3/4 are used; fold 2, folds 0/1, external held cohorts, and official test remain unopened.
A pass authorizes only separate folds-0/1 confirmation, not official-test scoring.
